caption: After step 3, notes.txt is gone yet the 300 bytes survive because hard.txt is a second directory entry for inode 1042; the link count went 1 → 2 → 2 → 1. soft.txt is a link on inode 2011 whose stored text is the name notes.txt, so with that name deleted the arrow has nothing to reach and the link is dangling.

spec.aria: A graph where the removed name notes.txt and the name hard.txt both point to inode 1042, whose link count fell 2, 2, 1 and whose data is 300 bytes; soft.txt points to a separate inode 2011 storing the text notes.txt, so its dashed arrow to notes.txt is dangling.
